body.locator: p. 10（The contentions of the two parties）
body.evidenceNote: 裁決書載明紐芬蘭的主張：「the contention of the Colony of Newfoundland is that the boundary should be “a line drawn due north from Ance Sablon as far as the fifty-second degree of North latitude, and should be traced from thence northwards to Cape Chidley along the crest of the watershed of the rivers flowing into the Atlantic Ocean.”」 證明紐芬蘭主張的範圍一路到大西洋水系的分水嶺；本紀錄的內陸範圍取自資料集，與這條分水嶺線的細節沒有另外比對。
body.gradeBasis: 樞密院司法委員會的裁決書本文（裁決機關自己的文件；對兩方而言都是第三方的官方紀錄）。Claude 看掃描圖逐字抄錄，2026-11-14，待複核。
